events.text: Cheongju Airbase was captured by DPRK forces.
Seonsan Village was captured by DPRK forces.
Chinju Nuclear Plant was recaptured by ROK forces.
DPRK air defenses fired on ROK aircraft southwest of Pangajae.
DPRK artillery bombarded ROK ground forces north of Pangajae.
Elements of the ROK 1st Infantry Brigade, 80th Infantry Division engaged DPRK ground forces east of Pangajae.
Elements of the ROK 1st Infantry Brigade, 80th Infantry Division engaged DPRK ground forces within Pangajae.
ROK artillery bombarded DPRK ground forces east of Pangajae.
U.S. F-14As engaged DPRK IL-28s northeast of Hwasun.
U.S. F-16Cs engaged DPRK MD-500s north of Andong.
